The '''Cirtappa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Alui sector/Legends|Alui sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cirtappa]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] attacked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy in the system. It was one of the first missions of [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] after he joined the Rebellion.
